rule.statement: Any interpretation of a statute that makes a time period mandatory would defeat the intention of the legislator.
rule.supporting_quote: I am of the opinion that any interpretation of Section 185(2) of the Pradeshiya Sabha Act No15 of 1987 on the basis that the time period of 3 months is mandatory, would defeat the intention of the legislator who intended to ensure good governance based on a transparent system.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 185(2) of the Pradeshiya Sabha Act No15 of 1987
